ideas.title: Egg Inspector [Anomaly]
ideas.hook: Work the night shift at an egg factory. Check every egg on the belt and pull out the ones that are wrong before they hatch.
core_loop: Eggs roll past on the conveyor
Inspect each one for cracks, eyes or odd colours
Reject anomalies and pass normal eggs
Survive the night and unlock the next shift
ideas.twist: Some anomalies only show under the UV lamp or when you look away, and missed ones hatch into creatures that roam the factory.
ideas.why_now: Job / shift momentum rose from 0.86 to 1.25 this week and is spread across 21 new games (Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 14.1K CCU, Fix My Phone! 9.7K). Interior maps are up to 2.21x across 27 new games (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 38.0K, Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) 14.6K), and Job / shift × Eggs is an open gap (4.28) on a theme with 55 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Anomaly games mostly use food or rooms; eggs add a payoff, because a missed anomaly hatches and hunts you for the rest of the shift.

ideas.title: Wrap Cars for Cash
ideas.hook: Cars roll into your wrap shop. Design a vinyl wrap with stickers, stripes and flames, and the customer pays more the cooler it looks.
core_loop: A customer drives in and asks for a style
Wrap the car with paint, decals and stripes
They drive it out and you get paid by their rating
Unlock rarer cars, chrome vinyl and a bigger garage
ideas.twist: Wrapped cars show up driving around the shared town and on the race track, so other players see your work and can order a copy from you.
retention: Car index of every model you've wrapped
Daily customer theme with bonus pay
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.04x with high confidence (11 new games, spread out), and its two biggest new games are vehicle games (Backseat Rally 19.3K CCU, [🎃] Kukirin Life [Testing] 17.3K). Vehicles rose from 1.03 to 1.34 this week across 22 new games ([🎃] Bike Universe 20.2K), and Job / shift is up to 1.25.
ideas.differentiator: Car games let you pick a paint colour; here designing the wrap is the whole job, and your designs drive around the server.

ideas.title: Joust for Gold
ideas.hook: Charge down the lane on horseback and knock the other knight flying. The further they fly, the more gold you win.
core_loop: Pick a horse and lance
Charge and time your hit
Send your rival flying for distance gold
Buy faster horses and longer lances, collect armour sets
ideas.twist: Hit timing decides the launch angle, so a perfect hit sends knights over the castle wall into a bonus moat for double gold.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.68x with high confidence (14 new games: Cat Battles 🐾 20.6K CCU, [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 14.2K). Fantasy / medieval rose from 0.86 to 1.37 this week (Pixel Lineage [🎃Spear Class + Dragon Race] 6.2K), and "___ for ___" titles are up 3.45x.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games fling players or stones from a standstill; jousting adds a timed charge and a rival who hits back, so each launch is a one-on-one duel.

ideas.title: Brew Potions for Adventurers
ideas.hook: Run a tiny potion shop. Mix ingredients in your cauldron, sell potions to adventurers, and grow it into the biggest magic store in town.
core_loop: An adventurer orders a potion
Mix the right ingredients in the cauldron
Sell it and restock from your herb garden
Expand the shop with more cauldrons and shelves
ideas.twist: Wrong mixes don't fail: they make weird potions (shrink, float, turn into a frog) that you can test on yourself or prank other players with.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop rose from 1.51 to 2.08 this week and is now spread over 17 new games (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 38.0K CCU, Eat Everything In A Grocery Store 9.5K). Fantasy / medieval rose from 0.86 to 1.37, and interior maps are up 2.21x.
inspired_by: Eat Everything In A Grocery Store
ideas.differentiator: Shop games sell fixed goods; here recipes are a puzzle and failed brews are a toy, so mistakes are part of the fun.

ideas.title: Kick Piggy Banks for Cash
ideas.hook: Kick giant piggy banks down the street. They smash open where they land, and coins spray everywhere.
core_loop: Charge a kick and launch a piggy bank
Watch it bounce and smash
Collect the coins that spill out
Upgrade your kick and unlock golden and diamond piggies
ideas.twist: Rare piggies have a coin multiplier painted on their side, but they're heavier, so you trade distance for a bigger payout.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is up 1.78x with high confidence: 41 new games, spread out (Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 41.0K CCU, Don't Steal My Eggs! 10.9K). Hit / swing / launch is up 1.68x across 14 new games (Cat Battles 🐾 20.6K, [🎃] +1 Stone Skipping 14.2K), and "___ for ___" titles are up 3.45x.
ideas.differentiator: Most money games show cash as a number; here the money is a physical object you launch and smash, which makes every payout a visual moment.

ideas.title: Truck Crates Up the Cliff
ideas.hook: Load your pickup with wobbly crates and drive them up a steep cliff road. Every crate that makes it to the top gets paid.
core_loop: Stack crates in your truck bed
Drive up the cliff road without spilling
Get paid for each crate delivered
Upgrade suspension, straps and bigger trucks
ideas.twist: Friends can ride in the back to hold crates down, so co-op runs earn more but one bad bump can throw everyone off.
ideas.why_now: Vehicles rose from 1.03 to 1.34 this week across 22 new games ([🎃] Bike Universe 20.2K CCU, [BETA EVENT!] Turbo Soccer : Beta 1.0 7.5K). Linear course maps rose from 1.47 to 1.75 across 42 new games, realistic art is up 2.07x, and Physics Sim is up 1.40x (Crazy Diver 7.4K).
ideas.differentiator: Driving games reward speed; here going slow and steady wins, and the cargo physics is the challenge.

ideas.title: Paint Sneakers for Hype
ideas.hook: Customise blank sneakers with paint, laces and patches, then drop them in limited runs. If players want them, the price goes up.
core_loop: Paint a blank sneaker
Choose how many pairs to drop
Players and NPCs buy and wear them
Spend profits on rarer blanks and a bigger store
ideas.twist: Every sneaker you sell is wearable, so your designs spread around the server and the most-worn pair each day gets a hype bonus.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.04x with high confidence (11 new games, spread out). Fashion / beauty is up 1.39x across 11 new games ([UPD✨] Makeup Salon💄 8.2K CCU, Facecard: Makeup Showdown [⭐UPD] 7.9K), and Sell / run a shop rose to 2.08 this week.
ideas.differentiator: Sneaker games flip shoes others made; here you design them, and players actually wear your designs.

ideas.title: 7 Nights With a Dragon
ideas.hook: A wizard leaves you his baby dragon for a week. Feed it, play with it, and keep it from burning the house down.
core_loop: Each night the dragon has new needs
Feed, bathe and calm it before it gets angry
Put out fires and fix what it breaks
Survive all 7 nights to keep the grown dragon
ideas.twist: How you treat it changes what it grows into: a calm dragon becomes a pet you can ride, a neglected one becomes the boss of night 7.
ideas.why_now: Job / shift rose from 0.86 to 1.25 this week (Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 14.1K CCU), and care-for-a-week games are breaking out (7 Days Cat-Sitting 14.2K, Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) 14.6K). Fantasy / medieval rose from 0.86 to 1.37 and interior maps are up 2.21x.
ideas.differentiator: Pet-sitting games use cats and babies; a dragon raises the stakes (fire, flying, growing) and gives a payoff you keep at the end.

ideas.title: Valet Rush
ideas.hook: Park guests' cars as fast as you can without a scratch. Fast, clean parking earns big tips; dents come out of your pay.
core_loop: Grab the keys of an arriving car
Drive it into a free space in the garage
Bring it back when the guest leaves
Spend tips on more floors, better valets and fancier guests
ideas.twist: Rich guests arrive in supercars that are fast but twitchy, so the best tips come with the highest crash risk.
retention: Car index of every model parked
ideas.why_now: Job / shift rose from 0.86 to 1.25 this week across 21 new games (Fix My Phone! 9.7K CCU, Save the Krusty Krab 🍔 14.1K). Vehicles rose from 1.03 to 1.34 across 22 new games ([🎃] Bike Universe 20.2K), and interior maps are up 2.21x.
ideas.differentiator: Parking games are solo puzzles; this one is a timed job with customers and a garage you grow, so it plays like a shift game with driving.

ideas.title: +1 Armor Every Step
ideas.hook: Every step adds +1 armor. Walk until you're a giant armored knight, then storm castles and beat their bosses.
core_loop: Walk to gain +1 armor per step
Your knight grows bigger and tougher
Storm the next castle and beat its boss
Open chests for helmets and shields, then rebirth
ideas.twist: Armor slows you down, so you pick between a fast light knight for racing between castles and a slow tank for bosses.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action rose from 1.70 to 1.86 this week with high confidence (27 new games: [🌍WORLD 2] +1 Venom Evolution 10.6K CCU, +1 Assassin Leveling 10.1K). Fantasy / medieval rose from 0.86 to 1.37, and "+1 ___" titles are up 2.02x.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games mostly pump speed or strength; armor has a real trade-off (speed vs toughness), which gives players a choice the genre usually skips.
